0022600170.text: The Golden State Warriors (4-3, riding a four-game winning streak) host the Phoenix Suns (1-3, on a two-game losing streak) in the Warriors' 8th game of the season, with Golden State 2nd in the Pacific and 1 game back, 9th in the West, and Phoenix 3rd in the Pacific and 2.5 games back, 12th in the West. Golden State is missing Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with a knee issue, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery). The Suns won the last meeting 131-122 in Phoenix on October 24, 2026, and the Warriors trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after winning the 2025-26 series 3-1.
